# ReceiptToCSV

> Receipt scanning SaaS that turns photographed or uploaded receipts into an organized expense report — itemized totals, taxes, and payment method included, exportable as CSV, PDF, or JSON. Available as a web app and native iOS/Android apps. No login required to try it.

ReceiptToCSV uses AI to extract structured data (store, line items, totals, taxes, payment method) from receipt photos or PDFs, with duplicate detection and support for batch uploads. Plans range from a free tier (20 scans/month) to Premium and Team tiers with shared organization scan pools, an admin portal, and an AI assistant for querying receipt history.
